name: Outsider
bio: A piscator who fights with dual blades and dual pistols. His Stealth state enables tactical repositioning and spawns Fang Spikes that strike nearby enemies on entry and exit — a durable frontline brawler.

skills.name: Shadow Veil
skills.desc: Enters [Stealth] status and exits [Hunt]. Spawns 2 [Fang Spikes] to attack random enemies within range when exiting [Stealth] status.

skills.name: Hunter's Strike
skills.desc: Retracts all [Fang Spikes] and enters [Hunt] status. Retracting each [Fang Spike] costs HP (minimum 1) to create an equal Ultra Shield and extend [Hunt] duration.

skills.name: Fang for a Fang
skills.desc: Damage taken spawns and fires 1 [Fang Spike] at the attacker (once every second max).

skills.name: Ravenous Gnaw
skills.desc: When not in [Hunt] status, Melee Weapons have a chance to spawn and fire 1 [Fang Spike] on hit at your target (once every second max).

skills.name: Air Dominance
skills.desc: [Only effective when deployed as a Combat Partner] Increases ATK for the character and nearby Anemo teammates.
